text.tu: Address the reader informally with "tu" (imperative and verbs in the second person singular). Never use "Lei" or "voi".

style.loanwords_text: Common technical loanwords (e.g. blockchain, token, bridge, smart contract) stay in English where that is the natural Italian usage; do not force awkward coinages. The terminology list below wins over this rule (wallet → portafoglio).
writing_rules: Use sentence case in headings, titles and terms, not English Title Case ("Configurazione fidata", not "Configurazione Fidata").
Use the articles "uno" / "gli" before z-, s + consonant, ps- and gn-, also with English terms and acronyms (uno zk-SNARK, gli ZEC, gli exchange).
Use Italian word order around names ("la documentazione di Valar Group", not "Valar Group documentazione").
English terms kept in English do not take a plural -s (gli exchange, gli zk-SNARK, le pool). Italian words take the Italian plural (portafoglio → portafogli).
Lowercase after a colon, unless a proper name follows.
Avoid calques of English: "una delle uniche" (one of the only), "con nessuna … richiesta", "componenti mobili" (moving parts).

shielded.context: Use "schermato/a/i/e" in prose. "Shielded" stays English only inside names (Shielded Labs, Shielded Coinholder Voting).

pool.context: "pool" is feminine in Italian: "la pool", "le pool", "pool schermata", "le pool schermate", "la pool trasparente".

node.inflection: It is NOT a loanword: use the translated term in compounds and plurals too.
node.context: A plain node is "nodo" / "nodi". Exception: "full node" stays in English (see full node).

viewing-key.context: Italian uses the plural even for one key (like "le chiavi di casa"): "chiavi di visualizzazione". The singular "chiave di visualizzazione" is fine when the sentence counts keys. Exception: the protocol names written with capitals in the English ("Viewing Key", "Full Viewing Key", "Incoming Viewing Key") stay in English exactly as written: "la Full Viewing Key".

custodial.context: Keep "custodial" / "non custodial" in English; at the first use on a page add the Italian in brackets: "custodial (custodia di terzi)". "self-custody" is "autocustodia". Never render "custodial" as "autocustodia" (opposite meaning).

zero-knowledge.context: As an adjective: "prova a conoscenza zero", "prove a conoscenza zero". As a noun or in titles: "conoscenza zero".

full-node.context: Keep "full node" in English (no plural -s); at the first use on a page add the Italian in brackets: "full node (nodo completo)". A plain "node" is "nodo".

spending-key.context: As for viewing keys: "chiavi di spesa", singular only when the sentence counts keys.

chain.context: Keep "chain" in English, like on-chain, cross-chain and blockchain.

grant.context: Funding given to a project. Names stay English: "Zcash Community Grants".

network metadata.context: Metadata about network traffic (IP address, timing). Also "network-metadata": "metadati di rete", never "metadati della rete".

oblivious synchronization.context: Project Tachyon: a wallet fetches the data it needs without the server learning which data it asked for. At the first use on a page add the English in brackets: "sincronizzazione cieca (Oblivious Synchronization)". Never "sincronizzazione ignara" or "sincronizzazione oblivious".

shielded supply.target: quantità di ZEC nelle pool schermate
shielded supply.context: The total ZEC held in the shielded pools. Never "offerta schermata".

voting chain.context: The separate blockchain built by Valar Group that runs the shielded coinholder vote: "la blockchain di voto".
